Local Workstation Workflow (`C:\DiscogsCollection\discogs_collection`) — v3.0

2-Step Daily Sync & Pressing Photo Picker (`sync_discogs.py` → `pick_pressing_photo.py`)

Run Anytime from PowerShell (`C:\DiscogsCollection\discogs_collection`)
cd C:\DiscogsCollection\discogs_collection
python scripts/sync_discogs.py
python pick_pressing_photo.py
git add -A && git commit -m "sync discogs collection & pressing photos" && git push

Both scripts anchor paths automatically to C:\DiscogsCollection\discogs_collection (even if run from inside scripts\), evaluate all release photos to default each record's wax ring to its pressing photo, sync the Keep flattening queue & collection value, and inject the compiled payload directly into index.html.

1 // PRESSING PHOTO DETECTOR
142 / 150 Releases Matched

pick_pressing_photo.py inspects every image in each release's gallery, handles both 1:1 and 4:3 camera photos, rejects 4" paper label closeups when a full 12" vinyl photo exists, and defaults the platter/wax ring to that photo.

2 // KEEP FLATTENING QUEUE
3 Queued • 40 Keep Entries Done

Synced with Google Keep's Vinyl flattening note via data/flattening_queue.json so every sync preserves your exact thermal plate queue and completed records.

3 // COLLECTION VALUE
Instant Static + Live Display

Pre-compiles both Discogs collection value ($6,011.87 Median / $10,437.49 Max) and the sum of all 150 release values directly into index.html so it never hangs on "Syncing...".

Interactive Deterministic Format & Pressing Parser Sandbox (Fallback for Sleeve-Only Releases)

Test any Discogs formats[].descriptions string + seller notes to see how parse_wax_variant() computes the fallback wax ring when a release has no vinyl photo on Discogs.
